tables.name: records
tables.label: Records
tables.description: The dataset this dashboard reads: one row per zone × scenario with the numeric measures. Import your own CSV with the same shape (zone, scenario, numbers) — everything below follows the data.

tables.name: zone_stats
tables.label: Zone totals (for the map)
tables.description: Per-zone aggregates the map paints — recalculated from the records with one tap, cached as rows.

tables.name: slices
tables.label: Saved views
tables.description: Named report configurations saved from the chart's bookmark — your slices.

tables.name: panels
tables.label: Report panels
tables.description: The report layout as rows: one row per panel. Add a row to add a panel, hide one to remove it, drag the divider between panels to resize — and each panel switches independently between the block kinds (chart, table, map, delta, KPI tiles, explorer, notes).

tables.name: notes
tables.label: Notes
tables.description: Free-text notes shown in a Notes panel — one editable Markdown row that travels with the report.

tables.name: dataconfig
tables.label: Data controls (saved)
tables.description: The databoard’s saved Data controls — one row per dataset holding its filters, grouping and sort so they survive restarts and travel with backups/share codes.
